label: Entity Framework Core (PostgreSQL)
description: Code-first entities with IEntityTypeConfiguration, a global soft-delete query filter on the DbContext, and migrations generated by dotnet ef.

vars.name: Entity Framework Core
quality_checks: Reads go through `Query`/`QueryById` (AsNoTracking) and rely on the global soft-delete filter — `IgnoreQueryFilters()` is never used without a written reason
Collection reads project to the DTO in the database so only its columns leave — never `ToListAsync()` on entities followed by in-memory mapping
Listing services override `Filterable`/`Sortable` and list only fields the API should expose
Extra filters are composed as `IQueryable` clauses in `ApplyCustomFilters`, never interpolated SQL
claude_rules: Soft delete is enforced by a global query filter on the DbContext — never call `Remove(entity)`, set `IsDeleted` instead
CRUD lives in `CrudService<TEntity, TId, TCreate, TUpdate, TListRequest, TListItem>` — derive from it rather than re-writing paging, filtering or sorting per feature
Never hand-edit files under `Data/Migrations/` — change the entity and run `dotnet ef migrations add`

protect-migrations.message: EF Core migrations are generated, not written. Change the entity or its IEntityTypeConfiguration and run 'dotnet ef migrations add <Name> --output-dir Data/Migrations' instead.

protect-generated-files.message: This is the generated EF Core model snapshot. Change the entity and run 'dotnet ef migrations add' — hand-editing it corrupts migration history.

context: Entities live beside their feature; EF configurations are in `Data/Configurations/`
Entities derive from `AuditedEntity` (Guid key) or `AuditedEntity<TId>` for any other key type
`AppDbContext` applies a global soft-delete query filter, so reads exclude deleted rows automatically
`CrudService<...>` in `Common/Services/` supplies GetListing/Create/Update/Delete, including paging, filtering and sorting
Migrations under `Data/Migrations/` are generated by `dotnet ef` and are never hand-edited
rules: Every entity change requires a generated migration (`dotnet ef migrations add <Name> --output-dir Data/Migrations`)
Derive CRUD services from `CrudService<...>` and override `Filterable`/`Sortable` — never re-implement paging or filtering per feature
Never call `Remove(entity)` — soft delete by setting `IsDeleted`

scaffold.$comment: Verified against the .NET 10 SDK with EF Core 10 and Npgsql 10.

commands.run: dotnet add src/<% project.pascal %>.Api package Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore
dotnet add src/<% project.pascal %>.Api package Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design
dotnet add src/<% project.pascal %>.Api package Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL

commands.note: skip if already installed; `dotnet tool update --global dotnet-ef` to refresh
